tokens.name: fond
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night keeps the legacy black (#000) with a faint blue bias; day uses the legacy whitesmoke family.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, the capsule rail. Night value is the legacy `.card` background #151515, unchanged.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or nested surfaces: table headers, inline code, quiz options.

tokens.name: ligne
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ligne-forte
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, quiz options). At least 3:1 on fond, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: texte
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on fond, surface and surface-2. Night value is the legacy whitesmoke.

tokens.name: texte-doux
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on fond, surface and surface-2 (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: soleil
tokens.usage: Prism stop 1 (legacy #FFFF00). Fills and gradients only. Never text on the day theme (1.02:1).

tokens.name: ciel
tokens.usage: Prism stop 2 (legacy #87CEEB, CSS skyblue). Fills and gradients; as text only at night.

tokens.name: braise
tokens.usage: Prism stop 3 (legacy #ff512f). Fills and gradients.

tokens.name: fuchsia
tokens.usage: Prism stop 4 (legacy #dd2476). Fills and gradients.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Prism stop 5 (legacy #1c64ff). Fills and gradients; 4.9:1 with white text on it.

tokens.name: grenat
tokens.usage: Legacy `darkred` of the portrait ring. Decorative rings only (2.1:1 on black, so never a meaningful mark).

tokens.name: lien
tokens.usage: Links and the active rail item, on fond, surface and surface-2 (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour, solid 2px outside a 2px fond gap; 4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ciel-texte
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the Définition callout, on the surfaces and on ciel-voile.

tokens.name: soleil-texte
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the Exemple callout, on the surfaces and on soleil-voile.

tokens.name: braise-texte
tokens.usage: Text for the Attention callout and wrong quiz answers, on the surfaces and on braise-voile.

tokens.name: fuchsia-texte
tokens.usage: Text for the À retenir callout, on the surfaces and on fuchsia-voile.

tokens.name: cobalt-texte
tokens.usage: Text for the Lettres & SHS callout, on the surfaces and on cobalt-voile.

tokens.name: ciel-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ciel-texte (Définition callout).

tokens.name: soleil-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind soleil-texte (Exemple callout).

tokens.name: braise-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind braise-texte (Attention callout, wrong answer).

tokens.name: fuchsia-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind fuchsia-texte (À retenir callout).

tokens.name: cobalt-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cobalt-texte (Lettres & SHS callout).

tokens.name: juste
tokens.usage: Correct quiz answer: text and 2px border, always paired with the word « Juste ».

tokens.name: juste-voile
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a correct quiz answer.

tokens.name: voile
tokens.usage: Dark glass inside the Title pill (legacy rgba(20,20,20,.3) raised to .7 so white text reads 7:1 even over the yellow stop).

tokens.name: sur-voile
tokens.usage: Text on voile and on a cobalt fill.

tokens.name: verre-blanc
tokens.usage: Legacy glass of `.chevronbs` (rgba(255,255,255,.3)). Glass button ground at night only.

tokens.name: verre-noir
tokens.usage: Legacy dark glass of `.h1` (rgba(20,20,20,.3)). Kept for reference; too thin for text.

families.affiche: "IM Fell DW Pica SC", "IM Fell English SC", Georgia, serif
families.texte: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

groups.name: Affiche
groups.note: IM Fell DW Pica SC, the legacy title face, kept for display only: small caps from an 18th-century press.

styles.name: affiche-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero title.

styles.name: affiche-l
styles.usage: Section titles and the Title pill (legacy .h1 was 40px).

groups.name: Texte
groups.note: Literata, a reading serif, for everything people read at length.

styles.name: corps
styles.sample: Un système expert raisonne à partir de règles explicites.
styles.usage: Running text, max 68 characters per line.

styles.name: corps-s
styles.sample: Base de faits initiale : H, K.

groups.name: Signal
groups.note: Rajdhani, from the legacy font import, for labels the machine speaks.

tokens.name: espace-1

tokens.name: espace-2

tokens.name: espace-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; list gaps.

tokens.name: espace-4
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: espace-5
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs groups and components.

tokens.name: espace-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wide screens; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: espace-7

tokens.name: espace-9
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room.

radius.note: Every legacy radius survives: 20, 27, 70 and the full circle.

tokens.usage: Inline code, inputs, table corners.

tokens.name: rayon-m
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, code blocks.

tokens.name: rayon-l

tokens.name: rayon-pilule

tokens.name: rayon-capsule

tokens.name: rayon-rond
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and the portrait ring.

shadow.note: The legacy glows, kept exactly, plus a quiet card shadow for day.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Glass button at rest (legacy .chevronbs). Day swaps the white glow for a hairline.

tokens.name: lueur-interne
tokens.usage: Carousel caption pill (legacy slider .h1).

tokens.name: halo-survol
tokens.usage: Hover on rail icons (legacy .icon:hover).

tokens.name: ombre-carte
tokens.usage: Cards and the drawer.

tokens.name: anneau-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element.

trait.note: Border widths. The legacy 27px frame is kept for posters only.

tokens.usage: Hairlines (legacy whitesmoke title border).

tokens.name: trait-controle
tokens.usage: Control borders and the focus ring.

tokens.name: trait-cadre
tokens.usage: Capsule rail outline (legacy .menu).

tokens.name: trait-prisme
tokens.usage: Luminous frame at component size.

tokens.name: trait-anneau
